summary: @servicetitan/standalone-root 1.11.7 ships install-time Bun-runtime dropper executing obfuscated payload
details: Version 1.11.7 of this previously-legitimate React/mobx MFE scoped package declares a preinstall hook (`node setup.mjs`) that downloads the Bun runtime binary from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases into a temp directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it to run the sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a 727 KB single-line, heavily obfuscated Bun-compiled JavaScript payload (obfuscator.io-style `_0xXXXX` identifiers, rotating string-array decoder `WV8StW`, ~2500-entry numeric/string-fragment table, `// @bun @bun-cjs` header) that is not referenced by `dist/index.js` and not documented in README or CHANGELOG (whose latest documented entry is 1.11.2). Using an alternate runtime (Bun) to execute an opaque payload at install time is a dropper pattern that bypasses Node-based scanners, and the alien-runtime execution is unrelated to the package's advertised React/mobx data-provider function. The combination of an undocumented version outside the CHANGELOG history, an install-time download-and-execute of a second-language runtime, and an obfuscated bundled payload is consistent with a maintainer-account or registry compromise smuggling code into a trusted `@servicetitan` scope.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
